tabs.problem.description: Tooltip of the warning mark on a tab whose page has something to resolve, such as workflow options that can't be saved (HI-3549), and read out with the tab's name.

tabs.problemNamed.description: A tab's accessible name while its page has something to resolve, such as workflow options that can't be saved (HI-3549); {tab} is its name.

tabs.unsaved.description: Tooltip of the dot on a tab whose page has changes not saved yet (Settings → Version Control's Combwork defaults, say), and read out with the tab's name.

tabs.unsavedNamed.description: A tab's accessible name while its page has changes not saved yet; {tab} is its name.

tabs.unsavedProblemNamed.description: A tab's accessible name while its page has changes not saved yet and something to resolve (HI-3549); {tab} is its name.

tabs.withNote.description: A dimmed tab's accessible name: {tab} is its name, {note} why it is dimmed (a CLI turned off, say).
